_comment: Canned harbor-town identities. The terrain build (build-terrain-region.mjs findHarbors) deterministically shuffles this list by map seed and assigns the first N to the N detected pier sites (N = min(sites, names)). Edit/extend freely — extra entries are simply unused on maps with fewer sites; add more than the site count to vary which towns appear per seed. 1700s Caribbean / pirate theme.

towns.name: Port Royal
towns.description: A notorious free port — rum, plunder, and not a single honest soul.

towns.name: Tortuga
towns.description: A buccaneer's haven of careened hulls and louder taverns.

towns.name: Nassau
towns.description: A lawless pirate republic where the black flag flies openly.

towns.name: Bridgetown
towns.description: A bustling sugar port, its quay thick with merchants and redcoats.

towns.name: Kingston Quay
towns.description: A deep natural harbor crowded with traders and gun-decks.

towns.name: Cartagena
towns.description: A walled treasure port, heavy with Spanish gold and heavier guns.

towns.name: Havana Roads
towns.description: Gateway to the treasure fleets — galleons ride at anchor here.

towns.name: Saint-Pierre
towns.description: An elegant French harbor beneath a brooding volcano.

towns.name: Charles Town
towns.description: A genteel colonial port with a darker tide of smugglers.

towns.name: Bristol Cove
towns.description: A snug fishing anchorage that asks no questions of strangers.

towns.name: Gallows Point
towns.description: Where the Crown hangs pirates in chains as a warning to the rest.

towns.name: Smuggler's Rest
towns.description: A hidden inlet known only to those who trade by moonlight.

towns.name: Black Harbor
towns.description: A grim volcanic cove of black sand and blacker dealings.

towns.name: Dead Man's Wharf
towns.description: A rotting pier and a tavern that has outlived all its owners.

towns.name: Cutlass Bay
towns.description: A rowdy careenage where disputes end at the point of a blade.

towns.name: Marigot
towns.description: A sleepy French roadstead of fishing smacks and salt-pans.

towns.name: Spanish Wells
towns.description: A freshwater stop the galleons favor — and pirates watch.

towns.name: Crooked Anchorage
towns.description: A twisting channel that wrecks the unwary and shelters the wise.

towns.name: Saint George's
towns.description: A fortified harbor ringed by batteries and brick warehouses.

towns.name: Willemstad
towns.description: A tidy Dutch trading post, orderly to the last guilder.

towns.name: Basseterre
towns.description: A French sugar harbor with a fort frowning over the roads.

towns.name: Falmouth Reach
towns.description: A wide sheltered bay, a favorite of the homebound fleet.

towns.name: Rum Cay
towns.description: Little here but a still, a pier, and very cheap liquor.

towns.name: Parrot Key
towns.description: A bright sandspit of fishermen, gulls, and idle rumor.

towns.name: Maracaibo
towns.description: A sweltering lagoon port, rich and ripe for the taking.

towns.name: Petit Goâve
towns.description: A buccaneer outfitting town — powder, shot, and salt pork.

towns.name: Stormhaven
towns.description: A storm-battered refuge harbor with stout stone moorings.

towns.name: Coral Landing
towns.description: A shallow reef-girt jetty, treacherous but well-loved.

towns.name: Wreckers' Town
towns.description: It lives off the cargoes the reef so kindly provides.

towns.name: Mutiny Cove
towns.description: Named for the crew that left their captain on the sand.

towns.name: Galleon Bay
towns.description: A broad anchorage where the great ships once watered.

towns.name: Saltmarsh
towns.description: A reeking salt-works harbor, profitable and proud of neither.

towns.name: Iron Bound
towns.description: A garrison port bristling with cannon and short tempers.

towns.name: Drowned Sailor
towns.description: A foggy cove with a chapel for those the sea kept.

towns.name: Pelican Roost
towns.description: A ramshackle pier under a perpetual cloud of seabirds.

towns.name: Cay Verde
towns.description: A green-fringed islet harbor, sweet water and sweeter fruit.

towns.name: Buccaneer's Hold
towns.description: A fortified pirate stronghold cut into the headland.

towns.name: Turtle Harbour
towns.description: Where crews stop to take on meat and mend their decks.

towns.name: Lantern Bay
towns.description: Famed for the false lights wreckers hang on stormy nights.

towns.name: Calico Landing
towns.description: A gaudy little port flying more colors than any flag-locker.

towns.name: Whydah Reach
towns.description: Named for a treasure ship that never made the open sea.

towns.name: Cannon Cove
towns.description: A natural fort where a single battery commands the entrance.

towns.name: Sirens' Anchorage
towns.description: Sailors swear they hear singing on the reef at slack tide.

towns.name: Doubloon
towns.description: A boomtown grown fat on one very lucky prize.

towns.name: Fort Liberté
towns.description: A French frontier harbor, half-built and wholly defiant.

towns.name: Brigand's Bay
towns.description: A shallow refuge for the small, the fast, and the wanted.

towns.name: Cockleshell
towns.description: A modest fishing pier and a very fine oyster bed.

towns.name: Hangman's Reef
towns.description: Beautiful, deadly water that has drowned a hundred crews.

towns.name: Sugarloaf Port
towns.description: Sweet trade by day, sweeter contraband after dark.

towns.name: Last Chance
towns.description: The final watering stop before the long blue empty.
